div.head: Cn 1020 12
div.ab: ⁊ gyf hwa þeof friðige oððe forena forlicge, sy he emscyldig wið me þam ðe þeof scolde, buton he hine mid fulre lade wið me geclænsian mæge.
⁊ gyf hwa þeof friðige oððe forena forlicge, sy he emscyldig wið me þam ðe þeof scolde, buton he hine mid fulre lade wið me geclænsian mæge.
And gyf hwa þeof friðige oððe forena forlicge, sy he emscyldig wið me þam ðe þeof scolde, buton he hine mid fulre lade wið me geclænsian mæge.

Und wenn jemand einen Dieb schirmt oder vertretend [für ihn] sich einlegt, sei er mir gegenüber gleich dem [Strafmaasse] schuldig, das der Dieb schuldet, ausser wenn er sich mir gegenüber durch vollen Beweis zu reinigen vermag.
And if anyone protects a thief or intercedes [for him], let him be liable to me for the same [penalty] as the thief, unless he can clear himself to me with full proof.

And if anyone protects a thief or takes action on his behalf, he shall incur the same penalty at my hands as the thief was liable to, unless he can clear himself to my satisfaction with a full oath of exculpation.

And if anyone gives asylum to a thief or interferes on his behalf, he is to be liable to the same penalty to me as the thief, unless he can clear himself of liability to me with the full process of exculpation.
Moreover, if anyone shelters a thief or intercedes on his behalf, he will be as deserving of punishment before me as the thief, unless he can be cleared by fully vindicating himself before me.
